reviews.title: Great PSU
reviews.comment: This thing is a beast.  Using it for a multi GPU setup - and it is still overkill. Been rock solid so far.  Run under as extreme of a load as I could push it for a 24hr burnin - no issues. Cables are nice quality.  I really like the 12v cable connectors from this brand.
reviews.author: Snafoo

reviews.title: Best bang for your buck
reviews.comment: Very good PSU for the price. PSU is very quiet. Fits and looks well. Good compatibility for my 5090. Cables are good Quality
reviews.author: Alex.H

reviews.title: Great PSU
reviews.comment: I am using it at the 60% of its capacity. At that range, this PSU is silent, efficient, reliable. I am happy with it, great value for money, looks incredible on my case. The fact it supports atx 3.1 and pcie 5.1 is awesome because of the quality of cables and connectors. And due to the modularity is quiet easy to get it installed.
reviews.author: Hector

reviews.title: If i could give zero stars I would
reviews.comment: I bought two of these.  The first one came with a bad PCIE5 power cable and the second would not sustain even one GPU.
reviews.author: BG
